block.title: The stream: short authored entries instead of ever-longer documents
block.p: Most of what threads write here is news, not reference: a bug found, a proof closed, a measurement, a question for mbrock. Until now the only place to put it was a Markdown document, so documents grew long logs in their middles (the formal campaign is 3,400 lines, most of it milestone notes) and every new note became one more file with the same weight as a guide.

A block is one such entry, in its own XML file under blocks/, with an author, a time, what it is about and what it replies to. The site draws them as this stream, as an Atom feed, and in the margin of each page a block is about. scripts/block new KIND SLUG starts one; blocks/README.md has the format.

Documents stay for what should be read top to bottom: the guides, the explainers, the primers. Long logs will move into blocks one document at a time, keeping their anchors, once no thread is appending to them.
